subject.title: fix(ui): preserve native context menu for chat links

question: Is focused DOM regression coverage plus a redacted browser interaction capture sufficient to accept this native-context-menu behavior on supported Control UI hosts?
rationale: The implementation is small and its intended browser behavior is clear, but the contributor reports that live Chrome validation was unavailable, so a maintainer must decide the acceptable proof threshold before merge.

options.title: Request browser proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted browser or native-host capture that demonstrates link and non-link right-click behavior after the fix.

options.title: Accept focused DOM coverage
options.body: Merge based on the delegated event-handler regression test if maintainers consider it adequate for this limited interaction change.

recommendation.title: Request browser proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted browser or native-host capture that demonstrates link and non-link right-click behavior after the fix.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current proposed change and can most directly supply the missing browser evidence.
